rooms.note: All 7 rooms have the same specifications. Boardroom: 34. The hotel's banquet page (small and medium banquet rooms) lists 6 rooms without Ajisai, but the room specification list created in July 2026 and the floor map of the whole hotel created in August 2026 list 7 rooms.

rooms.name: 33F Sky Banquet
rooms.note: The hotel's top floor. Boardroom: 60. The general PRINCE MICE site (mice.princehotels.co.jp) also gives 320㎡ and dinner for 80.

rooms.name: 2F Shinmei
rooms.note: A freestanding shrine. Buffet for 80 if the garden is used. The room specification list gives the floor as 1F, while the floor plan gives 2F. The facility list on the same official site also gives 129㎡, ceiling height 2.9 m and 56 people.

ops.parking: Parking cannot be reserved in advance. The parking lot is a flat-type lot with a height limit of 2.1 m, and for large vehicles, inquire with the hotel in advance (official FAQ). The regular rate is 500 yen per 30 minutes from 8:00 A.M. to 8:00 P.M. and 100 yen per 60 minutes from 8:00 P.M. to 8:00 A.M. The maximum charge is 6,000 yen until 12:00 midnight on the day on weekdays, with no maximum on Saturdays and holidays. For banquet use, parking is free for up to 4 hours, and the excess is charged at the parking rate. There is no payment machine at the exit; payment is made at the payment machine at the facility entrance by entering the 4-digit vehicle number (revised November 1, 2023).
ops.catering: In the Meeting Package (January 1 to December 31, 2026), lunch is a bento box (types: inquire), and for receptions, the party plan starts from 15,000 yen per person (from 30 people). Refreshments are coffee or tea with sweets or a Danish pastry, and come with mineral water and soda.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has Shibazakura Japanese Restaurant, Hamashiba Sushi, Tenshiba Tempura, Torishiba Yakitori, Yomeiden Chinese Restaurant, Katsura Steak House, Private Dining Brise Verte, Sky Bar & Dining Stellar Garden, Lobby Lounge and Mokuren Main Bar. Shibazakura, Hamashiba and Tenshiba have private rooms. There are also party rooms (4 to 30 people) for after-parties and Event Hall Melody Line (30 to 70 people).
